title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・道なき道の果て

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I won the autumn Tenno Sho! I really beat my two top oshis!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But I never would have made it here if it weren't for my trainer and all the Umamusume I raced along the way… Oh, my feelings are out of control.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can't take much more. I love everyone shooo mush, I'm losing the vocabulary to describe it—no, wait! I've got one last thing to say!
